newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -NOTIONNEL SEEKS GAINS WHILE ABOVE 129.38.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -NOTIONNEL SEEKS GAINS WHILE ABOVE 129.38.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will aim higher on Tuesday having broken out of their recent trading range, technical analysts said.

"We would like to hold support at 129.38 and while it holds above there the immediate focus is to topside confirming the fact that we do have a small base in place," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London.
He said initial resistance was at 129.78 to 129.84, an area incorporating the low from mid-July at 129.80 which was a previous breakdown point.
"That is the major hurdle that the market faces," he said.
Sneddon said an initial failure was likely at 129.78, 84 but then the market would push higher in stages, towards a barrier at the 130.30, 130.40 band.
"That latter zone should be the barrier that prevents the whole of the uptrend resuming," he said.
But some analysts said notionnel looked more neutral than Bunds and would have to do a bit more to improve the outlook.

"If it gets towards 130.00 it would improve quite a lot, but overall the signals suggest the French contract will underperform Bunds on any upmove by Bunds," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking.
He said a band of congestion offered resistance around 130.30, 130.32.
To the downside, Ostwald said support was offered at 129.20 from Thursday's low and below that at 128.96 to 128.94, the lows of the recent range.
Sneddon also said there would be downward pressure on 128.94 if 129.38 gave way.
"The market would resume its sideways range of the past week," he said.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were at 96.52, up two basis points on the day.
